description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterCacheResource, which provides a method to register cache resources in the Smarty templating engine. It includes the method registerCacheResource that associates a cache resource handler with a resource name.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterCacheResource
classes.description: Provides functionality to register cache resources within Smarty templating engine.

methods.name: registerCacheResource
methods.description: Registers a cache resource handler with a specific resource name for a given Smarty template or object.
